Closes D8's chart-level format_type gap (F-L07-05): configure_axis(label_format="date_iso") now renders real dates instead of misparsing the resolved strftime pattern as a d3 numeric spec.

AxisStyleSpec.label_overlap.reason: axis_style_fill_from -> AxisStyleOverrides.label_overlap, consumed by layout_x_axis's collision cascade AND, as of Task 8 (D12, spec §4.9), by layout_y_axis via layout::axis::resolve_y_overlap — the y transpose of the same four LabelOverlap primitives, reading the same policy object. `None` still means 'no policy' on y (byte-identical), which is why Greedy and None differ there and not on x.

The Option<bool> widening (Task 8, D12, spec §4.9) is what gives the chart-level position a consumer without letting it clobber a per-channel fm.Axis(labels=).

AxisStyleSpec.orient.reason: axis_style_fill_from -> AxisStyleOverrides.orient, consumed by AxisInput::resolve_orient, for axis/axis_x/axis_y. For axis_y2 the override reaches AxisStyleOverrides.orient (fill-only, same as every other field) but has no concrete side to resolve onto: layout::layout_panel_axes unconditionally forces every secondary axis's orient to Right regardless of any override, per-channel or chart-level — deliberate design (secondary axes always stack outward on the right), not a wiring gap, so this is NOT a Task 8 item.

AxisStyleSpec.tick_count.reason: prepare::resolve_axis_tick_count — the single place a tick count is decided, resolving per-channel fm.Axis(tick_count=) > chart-level configure_axis(tick_count=) (per-axis section before shared, via ChartConfig::axis_field) > DEFAULT_TICK_COUNT. Resolved in prepare rather than filled onto the overrides bundle afterwards because the count decides how many ticks the scale GENERATES (Task 8, D12, spec §4.9).
